headline: Madrid's runners against Arsenal's high press
angle: Arsenal's front-foot press meets Madrid's direct transitions: whoever controls the second balls controls the night.

assertions.text: Madrid score freely at home, averaging more than two goals a game.
Arsenal press high with an eight jumping onto the holding midfielder.
Home advantage and chance quality give Madrid a slight edge.

key_battles.title: Six under pressure
key_battles.why: If Madrid's six turns away from Arsenal's eight, Madrid break into space behind the press.

tactical_battles.title: Arsenal press v Madrid build-up
tactical_battles.description: Arsenal's front two and an eight press Madrid's back line.

tactical_battles.title: Madrid transitions
tactical_battles.description: Madrid look for their wingers behind Arsenal's high line once the press is beaten.

prediction_adjustments.reason: Arsenal's only doubt is a squad player, while Madrid miss a starter.

uncertainties: Line-ups are predicted until about an hour before kick-off.
